CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue coordinates), an explicit origin/organization entry, and distinct status-like origin fields are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the same content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (colour labels bound to coordinate sets) are present for current and candidate referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status entries are given separately from the explicit content coordinate assignments for the same referent/time.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The text specifies layout rules, a presentation summary line, and explicit origin/representation metadata describing how content is organized/presented.
